name: Rational Geometric Mean and Fractional Tie-Breaker
description: Replaced the characteristic equation with a condition that the geometric mean $\sqrt{s_u s_v}$ must be irrational, hiding the $s_u \neq s_v$ check. Replaced the base-4 integer tie-breaker with a base-4 fractional sum $\sum s_i / 4^i$, preserving the lexicographical requirement while baiting naive implementations into TLE (by attempting exhaustive search to find the minimum) or WA (by floating-point precision loss for large $n$).
